description: Statewide Distributed Solar Projects: Beginning 2000 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset is based on solar interconnection data drawn from the publicly posted inventories of New York State’s electric utilities. This dataset represents the most complete source of installed distributed solar projects, including projects that did not receive State funding, for all of New York State since 2000. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Energy & Environment. Its tags are kwac, mw, mwh, pv, solar electric. The table has 18 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA). The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
